rationale: The change adds one registered trust level for a newly introduced evidence class; the registry mechanism already governs such additions, so the change extends it rather than inventing a parallel vocabulary.
trust_boundary: The added identifier is emitted only after the producer's existing attestation step, so the boundary at which trust claims enter the event stream is unchanged in location and ownership.
transformation_ownership: The producing component keeps ownership of mapping internal evidence states onto the extended registry; no consumer-side transformation is introduced and no ownership moves across the boundary.

alternatives.rejection_reason: None of the registered trust levels describes the new evidence class; reusing an existing entry would mislabel the claim and mislead every downstream consumer of the registry.
The addition is one registry entry within the existing contract's semantics and version policy, not an independently versioned boundary; a separate contract would fragment the trust vocabulary.

assurance_limitations: The compatibility classification records the author's declared contract-semantics impact; it is not a compatibility proof and does not replace contract governance review.
